criterion: Navigation: user always knows where they are / role boundaries enforced
description: The frontend has no route guard. Every role, including LAB_TECH (empty sidebar) and ACCOUNTANT (Dashboard only), loads all 13 pages by URL: Patients with full CRUD and export, Users with Edit/Delete/Reset password/Role & Permissions on every row, and Reports.
expected: Pages outside a role's permissions redirect, or show an access-denied state.
actual: 117 role×page loads, 0 redirects. Example: labtech-users.png shows the full staff list with all action buttons.
suggested_fix: Add a role check in dashboard-layout or middleware that reuses sidebar.tsx allowedRoles, and add matching @Roles on the backend controllers.

description: The sidebar links roles to pages whose core APIs return 403 for that role. MANAGER → Appointments shows 'Failed to load schedule / Forbidden resource'. NURSE and MANAGER → Rooms get 403 on /appointments/rooms. RECEPTION and PHARMACIST → Pharmacy Desk/Counter/Billing get 403 on /pharmacy/dashboard and /drugs.
expected: Every sidebar link opens a working page for that role.
actual: manager-appts.png shows a red toast plus an inline error. nurse-rooms.png shows all-zero counters.
suggested_fix: Align sidebar allowedRoles with the backend @Roles lists (appointments, rooms, pharmacy dashboard, drugs), or widen the backend roles.

criterion: Error states shown clearly (not as empty states)
description: 403 responses are rendered as real-looking empty data. The Dashboard says 'No appointments scheduled for today' for PHARMACIST, MANAGER, ACCOUNTANT and LAB_TECH while 7 appointments exist today. Rooms shows 'Total Rooms 0 / Available 0' for NURSE, MANAGER, PHARMACIST, ACCOUNTANT and LAB_TECH.
expected: A 'you don't have access to X' state, or the widget hidden.
actual: The empty state is indistinguishable from 'no data'.
suggested_fix: Have the dashboard and RoomManagement fetches distinguish a 403 and render a permission notice or hide the card.

description: If /auth/me fails (502 simulated) the sidebar shows every link, including Admin and Pharmacy, and the header and footer read 'Unknown User / Unknown Role'. No retry is offered. While /auth/me is slow the same full nav shows with 'Loading… / Unknown Role'. Mapped defect 19, confirmed.
expected: A skeleton nav while loading; on failure, an error with Retry.
actual: The full admin nav is exposed to a NURSE session.
suggested_fix: Return [] from filterNavigationByRole when role is undefined; add a retry banner in dashboard-layout.

criterion: Feedback: information is correct for the viewer
description: The doctor's notification bell lists appointments for other doctors. Dr. Shravya's bell shows 'UXW Nurse81617 on 08 Nov 2026', a walk-in booked with Dr. Praneeta during this walk. Mapped defect 5, confirmed live.
expected: Only the signed-in doctor's upcoming appointments.
actual: All branch appointments for the next 48h are shown.
suggested_fix: Filter by doctorId = req.user.id in the notifications query for DOCTOR.

criterion: Information stated once / consistent across surfaces
description: Stock alerts disagree. The Reports System Alerts strip says 'Low Stock 0' and the pharmacist bell says 'No notifications', while GET /reports/inventory returns lowStockItems: 4. Mapped defect 10, confirmed. NURSE and LAB_TECH bells show an admin summary that links to 'View reports & alerts', a page their sidebar hides.
expected: Low stock means below reorder level, consistently, and the pharmacist is notified.
actual: 0 on the alert surfaces vs 4 in the inventory report.
suggested_fix: Use the reorder-level comparison in getSystemAlerts; map bell links per role to pages the role can open.

description: The admin stat cards (Total Users, Active Users, Total Branches, System Status) are shown to every role, including LAB_TECH and ACCOUNTANT. Total always equals Active (12/12), and 'System Status operational' plus the 'All systems operational' alert always show. Mapped defects 8 and 9, confirmed.
expected: Role-relevant cards; Active ≤ Total; status reflects real health.
actual: Identical admin cards for all roles; the values are hard-coded or duplicated.
suggested_fix: Gate the cards with showAdminControls; compute Active from status; remove the fake status alert.

description: An unknown /dashboard/* path renders Next's bare '404 This page could not be found.' with no sidebar, header or Log out. Mapped defect 23, confirmed.
expected: A branded 404 inside the shell, with a way back.

description: At 390px the header is hidden: no global search, notifications bell, Branded switch or settings. Only the hamburger remains. Mapped defect 15, confirmed.
expected: A collapsed header with search and bell icons.
actual: The top bar shows only '≡ ClinicMS'.
suggested_fix: Render a compact header (search icon, bell) in the mobile bar.

description: The Dashboard 'System Status' card value 'operational' spills 14px past its text column and touches the trend icon tile (measured by geometry-audit).
expected: The value fits beside the icon, or wraps or truncates.
actual: The text runs into the icon box at 1280px.
suggested_fix: Add min-w-0 and truncate, or reduce the value font size, in the stat card.

description: The Pharmacy Desk command-center header is broken for every role. The four stat tiles (Sales/Invoices/Stock/Packages) overlap: labels collide ('Invoices Stock') and '0 pending' runs into '0 low'. 'Manual Daily Entry' is squeezed into a narrow 3-line column. The geometry audit reports 9 overflow spills (up to 23px). Pharmacy Counter has 3 similar spills.
expected: Tiles laid out at full width with readable labels.
actual: Overlapping tiles in a cramped area at 1280x800.
suggested_fix: Give the command-center stat grid its own row, or allow it to wrap; set min widths.

criterion: Navigation: user always knows where they are
description: Test Transcribe ('Voice Transcription Test – Test the OpenAI Whisper transcription API') is a developer test page in the Admin nav. It renders outside the app shell (no sidebar or header) and is reachable by every role by URL.
expected: Dev tools hidden in production nav, or rendered inside the shell.
actual: The only way back is a 'Back to dashboard' link.
suggested_fix: Remove it from the sidebar, or feature-flag it.

description: The DOCTOR sidebar footer wraps the user name 'Shravya Dermatologist' onto 2 lines, pushing the role label down. Unlike other roles' one-line footers. (The geometry audit also flagged 4 wrapped device buttons on Procedures, but they are below the fold and were not visually confirmed, so they are not logged.)
expected: Name truncates with ellipsis on one line.

description: Login is throttled to 5 per minute (the auth controller's @Throttle limit). Clinic staff sit behind one IP, so the shared limit is hit at shift change: 4 consecutive 429 'ThrottlerException: Too Many Requests' responses on the first login of this walk. The login page surfaces the raw throttler message.
expected: Per-account or higher per-IP limits; a friendly 'too many attempts, try again in N s' message.
actual: Repeated 429s; the user must wait an unspecified time.
suggested_fix: Key the throttle on the identifier plus IP; show the remaining wait time.
